title: doctor, init, docs and the close
objective: `doctor` and the Hammerspoon half of `init`, the documents, and the close. `doctor` names every precondition with its state: Hammerspoon running, the `hs` tool present and IPC loaded, Accessibility, separate spaces, auto-rearrange, Stage Manager. `init --yes` installs the `hs` tool under `/opt/homebrew` and appends the one `require("hs.ipc")` line; without `--yes` it says what it would do. `help/arngz.md`, the README's utility table, the CHANGELOG entry, and the hand-run acceptance transcript in `acceptance.md`. `bin/devbin check all` and `utilz test` green before the package closes.
